changelog:
Fast cars, bikes and motorbikes close to a camera are caught even when a busy recorder drops frames.
Off-site backup keeps going when one queued file is damaged, and queued footage survives a power cut.
Opening a recorder from the Site Manager works when its clock is a few minutes off, and the app says why when it can't.
Disconnecting the Site Manager, or removing someone from the site, ends their remote video straight away.
The logo in the header sits centred over the side menu.
In the Site Manager, changing your email asks for your password, and you get an email when your email or password changes.
Security fixes to Site Manager sign-in and remote access.
